assembly_notes: Four component slots form 54 complete structural combinations; well_count adds a multiplicity of 4 values for 216 raw combinations. Every combination builds: the case, lid, carriers, well recesses and closure hardware all derive from one profile family plus a per-form inscribed-rectangle factor and a per-form profile half-width function, so the clover and round hosts still carry the well grid, the hinge knuckles, the seat pads and the latch pocket. Part tree: compact_case (root) -> mirror_lid (revolute, axis -X, lower=closed), -> carrier_count well_carrier parts (revolute about -X for the lifting topologies, about +/-Z for the fan-out leaves), -> 0 or 1 closure_actuator (prismatic +Y for push_latch, revolute +X for over_center_latch). Every revolute/prismatic joint is solved from an AxisInterface pair and registered with register_interface_mate; the pan field and the lid mirror are placed with mate_planes against real supporting footprints. No overlap allowances: hinge barrels abut real knuckles axially, the plunger flange is captured behind a narrower throat, and leaf hubs ride a stepped thrust boss. model.meta['motion_interlocks'] encodes the real operating order (lid open before any carrier, upper tier before lower tier, latch released before the lid opens).

derived.name: open_inset_m
derived.rationale: One stepped ledge per tier; each carrier fits its own opening and cannot fall through the narrower opening below it.

derived.name: carrier_width_m
derived.rationale: Carrier footprint with real side clearance inside the cavity.

derived.expression: floor_thickness_m + gap, then + carrier_thickness_m + gap per tier
derived.name: carrier_seat_z_m
derived.rationale: Seat heights come from the free cavity height, never from magic numbers.

derived.name: carrier_hinge_y_m
derived.rationale: The carrier hinge line walks forward until the chosen profile is wide enough to carry its knuckles and stays clear of the lid hinge.

derived.name: carrier_knuckle_x_m
derived.rationale: Carrier and lid hinge hardware never share an X band, so no swept pose can bring them into contact.

derived.name: well_field_half_w_m
derived.rationale: The inscribed rectangle of the chosen profile, so no pan overhangs a round or clover carrier edge.

derived.name: well_pitch_m
derived.rationale: Square cells keep every pan inside the declared field extent.

derived.name: pan_radius_m
derived.rationale: mate_planes rejects any station whose footprint leaves the field.

derived.name: latch_housing_w_m
derived.rationale: Housing and throat widths follow the host width for every profile.

derived.name: toggle_cheek_x_m
derived.rationale: Fork cheek stations follow the host width, and the pedestals overlap the front wall so the fork is really carried.

derived.name: keeper_out_m
derived.rationale: Lid keeper projects past the arm so the hook can wrap it with a real 0.4 mm vertical clearance.

multiplicities.host_capacity_expression: 2 <= well_count <= 8; pan_radius_m = 0.5*well_diameter_ratio*min pitch over the active carriers, so the grid always fits the carrier footprint that the case cavity allows
multiplicities.name: well_count
multiplicities.spacing_expression: wells split as evenly as possible across carrier_count, then laid out on a cols x rows grid of pitch min(2*half_w/cols, 2*half_d/rows) for the lifting carriers and on a constant-radius arc of pitch 2*leaf_ring_radius_m*sin(span/(2*(n-1))) for the fan-out leaves
